title: Label propagated along a path
statement: Let $q$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $G$ be a finite unique game with a nonempty finite set of variables and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences. Each constraint joins two distinct variables and carries a permutation of the $q$ labels, and every variable occurs in a constraint. Given a label in $	ext{Fin}(q)$ for each connected component, assign to each variable the label obtained by transporting its component's label from the component representative along a walk to that variable.
